abstract.t: This document discusses the drawbacks of the current practice of assigning a UDP port to each multicast application. Such assignments are redundant because the multicast group address already uniquely identifies the data. This document assigns a UDP port specifically for use with multicast applications and lists requirements for using this port. This approach provides immediate compatibility with existing protocol stacks, and this document also defines host enhancements that help safeguard the ongoing cooperative use of this port by multicast applications.
